title: Coins: spendable balance separate from coins collected
intent: Let the player spend coins on the gate and weapons without lowering their score

evidence.description: introduced the split balance and collected total
after buying the 60-coin gate, balance 0 and collected 60; five more kills gave balance 20 and collected 80

constraints.statement: Run.spend lowers only the balance; RunStats.coins, the end-screen Coins collected and the high score all use coins collected, which spending never lowers
Rewards are frozen once the run is over; a kill by a bullet still in flight after death earns nothing

result.summary: High score is the most coins collected in one run
